stories.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
stories.reason: Origin of today's biggest AI story: a new 'decision model' class (typed yes/no/choice/rating heads instead of free text) that already spawned a dozen clones and parodies in the pool (Kev, jevals, jev-chat-jarvis, openJev-verdict) within a day — a genuinely new LLM shape, not a rehash of yesterday's Kev pickup.
key_facts: Simon Willison write-up of the 'Jev' decision-model paradigm: single forward pass returns calibrated probabilities for typed questions instead of generated text
Spawned same-day open clones (Kev, on Qwen3.5) and eval tooling (jevals) already in today's pool

stories.title: Xiaomi MiMo v2.6
stories.reason: Xiaomi ships MiMo v2.6, a fresh open-weight model update not covered in any prior digest draft — genuinely new, high HN engagement (556 pts) already visible.

stories.title: Show HN: Mini-AGI – Dynamic continual learning model trained on 8GB VRAM
stories.reason: Continual-learning byte-level model trained on 8GB VRAM via disk/RAM/VRAM expert paging, adaptive per-token depth, and a 100x LR gap between trunk and experts that cut catastrophic forgetting from +2.23 to +0.0067 nats — concrete, verifiable, running code, matches the 'how models are served/trained' weighting.
key_facts: Adaptive depth: 2 dense blocks + recurrent block applied up to 24x, per-token halting
Trunk trains at 0.1x the LR of expert-specific params; cut forgetting from +2.23 to +0.0067 nats over 524K chars
318.1M chars read, 169 experts, 0.8336 nats/char held-out loss, scaling exponent -0.239, R²=0.96

stories.title: bojieli/ai-infra-book
stories.reason: Comprehensive open-source AI-infra textbook (12 chapters: batching, KV-cache, speculative decoding, datacenter networking, accelerator tradeoffs) with 4.9k stars and companion calculation tools — directly on-taste and unusually thorough.
key_facts: 12 chapters covering inference/training workloads, accelerator tradeoffs, KV-cache, speculative decoding, multi-device networking
4.9k GitHub stars, 357 forks; includes runnable calculation tools and reproducible experiments

stories.title: Show HN: jevals – replacing LLM judges with typed Jev decisions
stories.reason: Replaces expensive/inconsistent LLM-judge calls with the new decision-model approach: typed state+questions -> calibrated probabilities in one forward pass, and cites LangChain measurements of 92x-913x score variance between LLM judges on identical traces — a concrete, verifiable evaluation-methodology finding, not just a tool announcement.
key_facts: $0.00006/trace, 244ms p50, vs 6-11 LLM calls per sample for traditional LLM-judge pipelines
Cites LangChain finding of 92x-913x score variance between GPT and Claude judges on identical traces
37 built-in evals, alpha status, OpenAI/LangGraph/Claude SDK integrations
